<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

You get excited by doin' pervy stuff in front
a great view, don'tcha!?

You're tryin' to sexually harass me by
bringin' up such a lame topic, huh?
Then in that case...the answer is yes!
What kinda basic bullshit is that?

Hah! Are you the kinda perv that gets
worked up just by goin' for walks!?

Didn't expect such a manly idea from
you, virgin!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
